name: Easy Sheet Pan Bacon, Tomato, Corn & Onion Mixed Green Salad with Ranch

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 pint grape tomatoes
2 (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Divide between two baking sheet pans along with tomatoes and corn. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with spices, and stir to combine. Spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium red onion
3 cups frozen corn
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp taco seasoning
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice bacon. Sprinkle over the baking sheets.
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until bacon is crispy and veggies are golden and tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the veggies are almost done, place mixed greens in a large bowl, along with dressing, and toss to coat.
Using a clean cutting board, halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide dressed greens, roasted veggies, bacon, and avocado between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
